ratings.note: Every booking hits a 1.5 s silent wait at the commit point (probe 11/67); itself only uncertainty, but it invites the second press that cancels the booking. s=3.
Screen-reader users only, but for them the rubble/mattress limits and the vehicle error are not announced at the controls, risking a turned-away visit; recurs every visit. s=3.
Every Change slot / Back use resets to Today (probes 9, 18); a resident can silently book 14:20 on the wrong day; once known, the day is re-chosen. s=3.

Every done page lacks day, time and vehicle (screens 375/1280); the page is what is kept for the gate, no way to recover the time. s=4; rated 3 because the slot was just chosen and an SMS reminder is promised, so wrong-time arrival is a risk rather than the norm.

Only cancelled bookings that are reopened; the page still says Booked and Show this at the gate, a wasted trip if misread. s=4; rated 3 because the red cancelled line sits directly under the reference in the screenshot.
A double-tap during the unindicated 1.5 s wait (common on phones) stores the booking as cancelled (probe 73 after-second-press shows 'Cancel booking'); resident turned away at the gate. s=4.
Only expired holds; message gives no next step and drops the time, but Change slot sits in the same row. s=2.
Core change-slot task has no online route; needs a phone call (a support contact) and is impossible outside weekday hours, every change of plan. s=4.
Only presses within 900 ms of a day change; the press is lost and a retry works. s=1.
Viewports of 360 px or less; 320 screenshot shows the third column pushed past the page edge, needing sideways scroll; every visit on those phones. s=2.
Van bookings with a bad permit; error is plain text with no field on the page, recovery via Change vehicle is unsignposted. s=2.
Every car booking sees a permit field with no 'vans and trailers only' wording (probes 7, 28); car booking proceeds blank (probe 8). s=3; rated 2 because the effect is hesitation, not error.
Matters for van/trailer users; the rule is behind an unlabelled i icon, though the Opening days card also says vans and trailers need a permit. s=2.
Interrupted and older residents (declared common) can exceed the undisclosed five-minute hold and lose the slot only at Book; WCAG 2.2.1. s=3.
Keyboard and screen-reader users with vehicle/waste errors; focus lands on the document, one Tab or extra navigation recovers. s=2.
Van/trailer bookings with missing or malformed permit pass the vehicle step and fail only after all details and the wait (probes 27, 32); must go back unaided. s=3.
Every day change blanks the slot area for 900 ms (probes 2, 15). s=3; rated 2 because the gap is under a second and slots then appear.
Van owners without a permit must find the application elsewhere; one-time per permit. s=2.
Today is the default day and same-day booking is common; past slots look free and are rejected only after three steps. s=3.
Desktop only; grid stops at ~816 px of 1184 (1280 screenshot); visual, no task effect. s=1 (impact 0 cap).
Phone users choosing Another day; keypad lacks '/', but digits alone are accepted. s=1.
Mistyped permits only; message says 'needs a permit' beside 'permit 12345' (probe 60), misdiagnosing the fault. s=2.
Every booking; vehicle step omits day and slot (aria snapshots), a memory load for interrupted users. s=3; rated 2 because they reappear on the next step and nothing is blocked.
